jobDescription: A meditation and sleep app has 1.2 million monthly active users on iOS. The iOS Engineer builds features in Swift and SwiftUI, triages crashes after each release, implements in-app subscriptions with StoreKit 2 and keeps the app usable with VoiceOver. Releases go out every two weeks through the App Store. The interview panel reads each applicant's evidence summary and makes every hiring decision. The iOS team has three engineers who work with an Android team, a backend team and two designers, and reports to the mobile engineering manager. Most revenue comes from annual subscriptions bought inside the app, so changes to the paywall and to subscription handling are tested with the finance team before release. Every release also gets an accessibility review.
requirements: Builds production features in Swift and SwiftUI.
Implements and maintains in-app subscriptions with StoreKit 2.
Triages crashes for each release and fixes the top issues.
Keeps screens usable with VoiceOver and Dynamic Type.
Takes part in a fortnightly App Store release process.

evidence.text: Built the sleep-timer and offline-download features in SwiftUI for the Tidewell audio app, from design review to release.
Reviewed the Crashlytics report after each release and fixed the highest-volume crashes, including a Core Data threading crash on older devices.
Added VoiceOver labels and Dynamic Type support to the player and library screens, testing with the accessibility inspector.
Prepared release notes and ran the TestFlight checks for the fortnightly App Store releases.
Took part in a team workshop on StoreKit 2 ahead of a planned paywall redesign; the subscription code itself was maintained by the other iOS engineer.
Work sample: a pull request for the offline-download queue in SwiftUI, with the async download manager, unit tests and screenshots at three Dynamic Type sizes, approved by two reviewers.

Reference check summary: the candidate's engineering manager at Tidewell confirmed in writing that the candidate shipped 34 App Store releases between 2022 and 2024 as one of two iOS engineers, citing the App Store Connect release history.
HR verification note: employment at Tidewell from March 2022 to the present as iOS Developer, checked against payslips and the employment contract supplied by the candidate.
